# Model comparison: SimpleCNN vs ResNet18

*Generated by `python -m src.compare` from the result files in this folder (`<model>_metrics.json`, `<model>_history.json`, `speed_benchmark.json`).*

- **Test set:** 3,726 cells from patients that no model ever trained on, and that were never used to make any choice.
- **Thresholds** were tuned on the *validation* set only.
- **Training time** is the sum of all epochs, as measured during training.
- **Speed** is the model alone (no image loading), measured on: Tesla T4, in batches of 64.

| | SimpleCNN | ResNet18 |
|---|---|---|
| **Size** |  |  |
| parameters | 389,153 | 11,177,025 |
| size of the weights | 1.6 MB | 44.7 MB |
| input image size | 128×128 | 224×224 |
| **Training** |  |  |
| training time | 12.5 min | 32.3 min |
| epochs run (best epoch) | 21 (17) | 24 (20) |
| **Speed** |  |  |
| cells classified per second | 5,089 | 1,247 |
| **Test set, default threshold 0.5** |  |  |
| accuracy | 95.57% | 96.83% |
| precision | 97.91% | 98.09% |
| recall (sensitivity) | 92.12% | 94.81% |
| specificity | 98.39% | 98.49% |
| F1 | 0.9493 | 0.9642 |
| missed infections | 132 | 87 |
| false alarms | 33 | 31 |
| **Test set, threshold tuned for 98% recall on validation** |  |  |
| threshold | 0.0730 | 0.1997 |
| accuracy | 91.79% | 96.91% |
| precision | 86.83% | 96.10% |
